say:3:1423104002:1.text: Honestly, it's a total dumpster fire!

say:4:1423104003:1.text: According to Hyla, most of the craftsmen are loafing around, and the few who listen to her can hardly keep things running.
say:4:1423104003:1.source_cn: 生产线那边，海拉告诉我，大多数工匠都在怠工，少数听她话...

say:5:1423104004:1.text: There's a group of veterans who only take orders from Ironbeard, but he's thinking about leaving the village for good.
say:5:1423104004:1.source_cn: 还有一批资历深的工匠现在只听铁须的话，他们都是技术上的...

say:6:1423104005:1.text: At this rate, all of the craftsmen in the village will soon be gone, leaving just us old timers behind...
say:6:1423104005:1.source_cn: 照这样下去，除了我们这些老顽固，村里的工匠很快就要走空了……

say:7:1423104006:0.text: When the time comes, we can forget about researching arcane steel or working with Sal'thorin!
say:7:1423104006:0.source_cn: 更别提研究魔钢和跟萨洛克兰合作这种事了！
